name: Adriel
overview: Adriel is a male figure identified uniquely as the Meholathite, indicating his origin or clan association. The biblical record provides limited information about his tribe or additional personal details. His mention is brief but significant within the biblical narrative.
namesAndTitles: The name Adriel means '[my] help is G-d [El],' reflecting a theistic affirmation common in Hebrew names. This proper name highlights a reliance on God, though it is not indicated that the name was given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Adriel as the husband of Merab, an inferred relationship, and explicitly names Barzillai as his son. Beyond these, the biblical text does not provide further family details about Adriel.
scriptureSignificance: Adriel's significance in Scripture is connected to his identity as the Meholathite and his familial ties, particularly through his marriage to Merab and his son Barzillai. His mention situates him within the broader historical and genealogical context of the biblical narrative, contributing to the unfolding story of God's people.
